usage: In-flight delivery report for a booked media buy — delivery KPI tiles (impressions delivered, reach, completion rate, spend) with a daily-delivery sparkline for pacing and optimization decisions.

dataMapping.completion_rate: Video completion rate as a fraction between 0 and 1 (number)
dataMapping.spend: Spend to date in the campaign currency (number)
dataMapping.daily_delivery: Array of daily impression counts (numbers) rendered as the sparkline
